snippet.title: Signs of Stress vs. Signs of Calm in Dogs #HappyDogTV #DogCare #DogLover
snippet.description:
🐾 Signs of Stress vs. Signs of Calm in Dogs

😟 Stressed or 😌 Calm? Here’s How to Tell

Dogs can’t say how they’re feeling — but their body language speaks volumes.

⚠️ Stress looks like: pacing, constant barking, tucked tails, avoiding eye contact.
💛 Calm looks like: slow blinking, loose posture, deep sighs, soft tail wags.

Knowing the difference helps you step in when they need comfort — and celebrate when they’re truly at ease.

At HappyDogTV, we design calming sights and sounds to help stressed pups find their way back to peace. 🐶✨

Ever noticed your pup twitching, paddling their paws, or softly barking in their sleep?
That’s their brain replaying the day — sights, sounds, and feelings all wrapped up in dreamland. ✨

Just like us, dogs dream about the things that matter to them: a game of fetch, a new friend at the park, or even the calm they felt while watching TV designed just for them.

That’s why the visuals and sounds they experience while awake are so important. Calming content can shape calmer dreams, while stressful experiences can lead to restless nights.

With HappyDogTV, your pup gets gentle, soothing stimulation during the day — so when it’s time to snooze, their dreams are full of peace, not stress. 💛

snippet.description:
🐾 Signs of Stress vs. Signs of Calm in Dogs

😟 Stressed or 😌 Calm? Here’s How to Tell

Dogs can’t say how they’re feeling — but their body language speaks volumes.

⚠️ Stress looks like: pacing, constant barking, tucked tails, avoiding eye contact.
💛 Calm looks like: slow blinking, loose posture, deep sighs, soft tail wags.

Knowing the difference helps you step in when they need comfort — and celebrate when they’re truly at ease.

At HappyDogTV, we design calming sights and sounds to help stressed pups find their way back to peace. 🐶✨

Their vision is unique — built for motion, not detail.

🌈 Dogs don’t see every colour — their world is mostly blues, yellows, and greys.
⚡ They’re better at spotting movement than fine detail.
